**As a** catalog administrator

**I need** to create and manage products in the catalog

**So that** customers can browse and purchase products

### Details and Assumptions

* Product information will be stored in the catalog database
* Only authorized administrators can modify products

### Acceptance Criteria

Given a catalog administrator
When a new product is entered into the catalog
Then the product is stored and available for customers
